question: Which of the following countries is a permanent member of the United Nations Security Council?
solution:
The correct answer is __**France**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **France** is one of the five permanent members of the United Nations Security Council (UNSC).
 
• The other four permanent members are **China, Russia, the United Kingdom,** and the **United States**.
 
• These five countries hold veto power, which allows them to block any substantive resolution.
 
• The permanent members were established after World War II, reflecting the major Allied powers' roles in the war.
 
• The UNSC is responsible for maintaining international peace and security.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The United Nations was established on **24th October 1945**, shortly after the end of World War II.
 
• The **UN Charter** was signed on **26th June 1945**, in San Francisco, at the conclusion of the United Nations Conference on International Organization.
 
• The UNSC has a total of **15 members**: 5 permanent and 10 non-permanent members elected for two-year terms by the General Assembly.
 
• The non-permanent members are chosen to achieve equitable geographic representation.
 
• The primary responsibilities of the UNSC include the establishment of peacekeeping operations, the establishment of international sanctions, and the authorization of military action through resolutions.
 
• The decisions of the UNSC are binding on all member states of the United Nations.
